versions.content: Completeness of new software. Type: draft Description: The FOTA Handler shall verify the completeness of received data as it was indicated by the FOTA Master ECU at the beginning of installation as prerequisite for activation. Note: Verification features and techniques are implementation specific and are therefore not part ot this document. Rationale: In order to ensure that the newly installed SW image is complete, which is a major prerequisite for booting the SW, a mechanism to provide this feature must be in place. Dependencies: Use Case: The completeness of the newly installed SW is a major prerequisite in order to indicate a successful installation procedure. Supporting Material:
